items.root_cause: The coverage gap -> worklist -> verdict loop cannot converge: (1) Read-MatchFindings keys one name per gap (the head candidate) instead of each actionable verdict, so 10 of today's 18 gaps have an actionable name that was never put in front of the matching lane; (2) audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 does not read match-verdicts.json or the board's quarantine block, so a decided claim or a quarantined cell stays actionable forever and the type keeps returning; (3) Get-MatchClassification's claimer-plus-target branch releases a name that carries the claimer's own word ('Krinos Tahini Ground Sesame Seeds') and widens a PRICED row, so the automatic road would move a correct cell onto the wrong commodity

root_fix.what: make the loop converge at its producer: key every actionable verdict, read decisions and the quarantine back into the audit, refuse the two wrong classifier shapes
root_fix.exact_change: match-worklist-lib Read-MatchFindings: foreach gap, foreach verdict with actionable=true, emit a row keyed on the VERDICT's candidate with that verdict's reason and claimer; skip reason PRICED (not a matching finding). Get-MatchClassification claimer+target branch: before 'release', compute claimerWordInName exactly as the aisle/band branch does (lines 156-161) and return undecided with why 'the claimer's own word <w> is in the name' when true. audit-coverage-gaps: load match-verdicts.json; a verdict whose key (coverage|commodity|store|candidate) has verdict confirm, moot, ad-line or known-wrong becomes reason DECIDED, actionable=false, detail naming the verdict; load the board's quarantine.cells and turn a PRICED verdict for a quarantined commodity|store into reason QUARANTINED, actionable=false, detail naming the guard reason

prevention.what: the emitting check and the worklist producer, not a rule file: the type returned because decided and quarantined gaps stay actionable and actionable names are never keyed, so every close repaired names while the count never fell

items.subject: Grocery: semantic sweep found 2 product(s) no rule can see (x2)
evidence: LANE MEASUREMENT CONFIRMED: both findings stand. laundry-detergent @ Family Fare 'Arm & Hammer Liquid Laundry Clean Burst' 43 oz $6.19 (0.144/fl oz, family-fare-regular-2026-07-12); hot-sauce @ Family Fare 'Trappey's Pepper Sauce, Cayenne, Red Devil 12 Fl Oz' $2.19 (0.1825/fl oz, family-fare-regular-2026-07-30, carried forward)

both sit UNDECIDED on the worklist. 'Arm & Hammer' reads as a noun list ('the name lists several foods (a conjunction between nouns)'): Get-MwlHead (match-worklist-lib.ps1:92-96) marks any '&' between two words not both in MwlAdj as a list, so a brand ampersand blocks every decision on an Arm & Hammer, Johnson & Johnson or Ben & Jerry's name. Trappey's abstains correctly (only one of hot-sauce's words is in the name)
items.root_cause: the classifier that should decide semantic findings automatically abstains on any name with a brand ampersand, so a semantic finding on an '&' brand can only be closed by a hand rule, and each return is worked from scratch

root_fix.what: a brand ampersand is not a noun list
root_fix.exact_change: Get-MwlHead: treat '&'/'and' as a list conjunction only when BOTH neighbours are commodity tokens (pass the token index Get-MwlTokenIndex builds, which Get-MatchClassification already receives as -Index); a neighbour that names no commodity (arm, hammer, johnson, jerry) is a brand joint and does not set list

prevention.what: the producer of the decision that should close a semantic finding without a lane: its list test made these two (and every '&' brand) undecidable
prevention.exact_change: as root_fix.exact_change; the developer re-runs the worklist over today's findings and lists every decision that changed (decision diff over all 1,132 rows)
